# Jimmy Liu

Jimmy Liu is a Mattel employee who has worked at Mattel since 2015. He currently works as Hot Wheels and Matchbox's director of product design; prior to this he served as a marketing manager. Prior to his work at Mattel, he worked as a banker at Wells Fargo and various other financial service companies before assuming an internship role at Mattel, which he later transitioned to full-time. He also designs castings but not on a regular basis.
